summary.text: Nathan Johnson is the Democratic nominee. A Dallas attorney and mediator, he has been a state senator since 2019 and says he has passed 134 bills across water, energy, education, health care and criminal justice. He campaigns on investigating corruption in the public and private sectors, consumer protection and antitrust enforcement, partnering with district attorneys, and suing the federal government over what he calls unconstitutional border policy.

paragraphs.text: Bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona and law degree from the University of Texas; litigator and mediator with Thompson Coburn in Dallas.
Texas Senate member since 2019, first elected in 2018, representing part of Dallas County.
